blocks.text: Visual Kanban boards that make task management intuitive

Trello popularized Kanban-style project management for non-engineering teams, and its core strength remains simplicity. Drag cards between columns, add checklists and due dates, and you have a functional project management system in minutes.

For small teams and personal productivity, Trello's visual approach reduces the overhead of task management to near zero. There is no training required - anyone who has used a sticky note understands Trello immediately. This low friction makes it ideal for teams where not everyone is comfortable with complex PM tools.

Trello's Power-Ups extend functionality when you need it - calendar views, custom fields, automation rules, and integrations with external tools. You start simple and add complexity only when your workflow demands it.
Visual drag-and-drop boards with customizable columns
Rich task cards with checklists, attachments, and due dates
Built-in automation rules triggered by card actions and schedules
Extend with calendar views, custom fields, and third-party integrations
Ready-made boards for project management, CRM, content calendar, and more
Full-featured iOS and Android apps for managing work on the go
For teams that find other PM tools overwhelming, Trello is the right starting point. Its simplicity is a feature - less time configuring, more time doing.
Our team can integrate Trello into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
